error.busy: it is in use: close the files and windows that use it
error.no-udisks: udisksctl is not available: install udisks2
error.timeout: udisks did not answer in time

notify.unsafe: {name} was unplugged while still mounted: files being written may be lost

panel.empty-hint: Plug in a USB drive or an SD card.
panel.encrypted: Encrypted volume: unlock it with its passphrase
panel.power-off-hint: Unmounts everything and powers the drive off

auto_mount.description: Mount the filesystems of a drive as soon as it is plugged in. Encrypted volumes still wait for their passphrase.
auto_mount.label: Mount automatically

file_manager.description: Command that opens a folder, which is passed as the last argument. Empty uses xdg-open.
file_manager.label: File manager command

hide_when_empty.description: Hide the widget while no removable drive is plugged in.
hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty

notifications.description: Notify when a drive can be removed safely. Errors and drives unplugged while mounted are always shown.
notifications.label: Notifications

open_after_mount.description: Open the folder in the file manager after mounting a volume.
open_after_mount.label: Open after mounting

scan_interval.description: Seconds between two reads of the kernel's device list.
scan_interval.label: Scan interval

show_count.description: Show the number of drives next to the icon.
show_count.label: Show the count
